comment: ANCHOR: DESIGN_CAPTURE_20261025 — Design workflow v000 capture (operator approved 2026-10-25; design/README.md; AGENTS.md §28.8, §28.13 proposed): scripts/lib/design_capture_guard.py refuses production 04:00-16:15 ET Mon-Fri and gates every page on portfolio-server MemoryCurrent (< 1.2 GB ok, >= 1.2 GB wait 30 s, >= 1.3 GB or unreadable abort); scripts/design_capture.sh consults the guard before any browser; e2e-live/design-capture.ts is GET-only and writes screenshots only to the private store (never inside the public repo); scripts/design_capture_ingest.py turns the manifest into BASELINE status.json fingerprints (role capture, width, tab; no image bytes, no host paths), re-hashes the private files, skips needs_reader pages (registry baseline_pending) and leaves design/ valid. Hermetic.
